analysis:
Scope: SSDPrefixCache.swift head 1256-2194 and SSDWholeRootMaintainer.swift base/patch. No regression was found.

What changed:
- The whole-root maintainer's TTL pass now passes `unusedSince = nowSeconds - ttlSeconds` (head 152-154). The value flows through `SSDDiskBudget.retireActiveEntries` to `SSDPrefixCache.retireOwnedEntries` / `retireIndexedEntries` (head 1790-1800) and on to `SSDOwnedEntryRetirement.remove`.
- Its intent: a loaded store keeps a file that its index saw hit after the TTL cutoff. This matches T-041(b): a 30-minute sliding TTL that slides on hit.
- Survivors of the TTL pass get their mtime re-read via `FileManager.attributesOfItem` (head 158-164). That value is used only to order the budget LRU pass. It is metadata-only, adds no new deletion target and skips nil results.

Why TTL still holds:
- The unloaded path (`performUnloadedDestructiveChange`) still deletes without the cutoff.
- A loaded store's own TTL sweep is unchanged: `sweepExpiredEntries` at 1851-1858 uses index lastAccess.
- Stage-path touches still bump both index recency and mtime (1578-1587). So retention cannot extend past the last real hit plus the TTL, provided `SSDOwnedEntryRetirement.remove` compares unusedSince against index lastAccess.

Unchanged and still intact:
- HMAC naming, DBK3 crypto and binding checks: stage 1392-1398, sidecar 1636-1651, scan 1930-1936, durable settle 2080-2085.
- Corrupt-file deletion and the staging reservation release paths: completeStaging/abandonStaging 1723-1755.
- Epoch semantics.

Remaining contracts for integration (implementations not supplied):
- `SSDOwnedEntryRetirement.remove` must treat unusedSince only as "keep if index lastAccess > cutoff". It must not skip the removal for entries absent from the index, and must not let a stale or forged mtime extend retention.
- `SSDDiskBudget.retireActiveEntries` must forward unusedSince and must return nil only when the store is not loaded.

Relevant threat: T-041 (TTL / LRU reuse-window bound, SEC-035 accepted oracle window). No threat-model text change appears required.
